## Professional Summary
Lead / Staff Product Designer and Design Technologist with 9+ years of digital product experience. Specializes in the intersection of UX strategy, scalable design systems, and frontend engineering for mission-critical enterprise platforms and emerging AI ecosystems. Track record includes architecting an in-house enterprise platform at Sberbank HQ replacing standard SAP Fiori for 20K+ monthly active users, and directing end-to-end product design for AI evaluation systems at QuantPi. Bridges the gap between product vision, complex business logic, and code through AI-augmented workflows (Claude Code, Codex, Storybook, React).

## Core Competencies & Skills
- **Product & Design Leadership:** UX Strategy, Complex Enterprise & B2B SaaS, Design Systems, Information Architecture, Wireframing, Rapid Prototyping, Customer Discovery & Generative Research, Usability Testing, Cross-Functional Team Leadership.
- **Design Engineering & Technology:** Figma, Storybook, Design Tokens, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Webflow, Git, Terminal & AI CLI toolchains (Claude Code, Codex, Grok).
- **Domain Fluency:** Enterprise ERP & SAP Modernization, Financial Workflows & Analytics, AI Validation & LLM Model Governance, Risk Profiling.

Sole designer from discovery to release in 6 months. NPS improved from 54% toward the 80% target. Case study: https://andreiddls.github.io/about-me/sc_platform.html
